fmr.description: Fair Market Rents for one county, town or metro area: monthly gross rent by bedroom count (Efficiency to Four-Bedroom); Small Area FMR metros give one row per ZIP plus 'MSA level'.

entityid.desc: 10-character county code (state FIPS + county FIPS + 99999, e.g. 5100199999), a New England town code, or a metro code (METRO47900M47900)

year.desc: fiscal year, e.g. 2027 (default: latest). FMRs take effect October 1 before the fiscal year (FY2027 on 2026-10-01)

fmr_state.description: Fair Market Rents for every metro area and county (towns in New England) of a state: one row per area, area_type metro or county.

year.desc: fiscal year, e.g. 2027 (default: latest). FMRs take effect October 1 before the fiscal year (FY2027 on 2026-10-01)

income_limits.description: Section 8 income limits for one area: median family income and Very Low (50%), Extremely Low (30%) and Low (80%) limits for 1-8 person households (il50_p1 ... il80_p8).

entityid.desc: 10-character county code (state FIPS + county FIPS + 99999, e.g. 5100199999), a New England town code, or a metro code (METRO47900M47900)

year.desc: fiscal year, e.g. 2026 (default: latest). Income limits take effect when HUD publishes them in spring, not October 1 (FY2026: May 1, 2026), so the latest IL year can trail the latest FMR year

il_state.description: Income limits for every area of a state (response shape not documented by HUD; unverified).

year.desc: fiscal year, e.g. 2026 (default: latest). Income limits take effect when HUD publishes them in spring, not October 1 (FY2026: May 1, 2026), so the latest IL year can trail the latest FMR year

mtspil.description: Multifamily Tax Subsidy Project (LIHTC) income limits for one area: 20% to 140% limits by household size.

entityid.desc: 10-character county code (state FIPS + county FIPS + 99999, e.g. 5100199999), a New England town code, or a metro code (METRO47900M47900)

year.desc: fiscal year, e.g. 2026 (default: latest). MTSP limits are released with the income limits in spring, not October 1 (FY2026 income limits: May 1, 2026)

list_states.description: States and territories with HUD state codes.

list_counties.description: Counties (and New England towns) of a state with their 10-character fips_code entity ids.

updated.desc: 2025 = the FIPS codes used by Income Limits 2025 (some counties changed)

list_metro_areas.description: HUD metro FMR areas with their cbsa_code entity ids (METRO10180M10180).

updated.desc: 2025 = the area codes used by Income Limits 2025
